primary_task: Write an exhaustive Markdown API or configuration reference for a codebase or system, extracted from its code.

requirements.name: read
requirements.basis: "read": "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)"

notes: Reading code is needed only when the code is in the working directory; the reference can also be written in the reply. "Accuracy: Verified against actual implementation" could mean running the code; any build or test tools would be installable from the open registries, so the verdict stays ACHIEVABLE under that reading too, unless the system to document lives behind a non-allow-listed host (unknown).
